ground_material_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 2x2 environment ground-texture atlas for original Rose game.
Primary request: Four seamless, opaque, overhead diffuse material textures, precisely filling equal quadrants of a square image. No borders or gutters. Each quadrant is a uniform, naturally varied surface sample without isolated objects, hard scenery or shadows cast by buildings.
Top left: ash-dark compact soil, tiny resin-dark root filaments, worn moss, darkwood fiber and very sparse fine jade mineral flecks, druid woodland material.
Top right: worn oxidized steel panels embedded in stone grit, nano conduit seams, cool slate tones with tiny subdued cyan imperfections.
Bottom left: cultivated foothill earth, grey ochre dust, copper mineral grains, subtle fine grass roots.
Bottom right: wind-worked mauve-grey dust, fine crystalline fragments, restrained jade and rose grains, nano-neon dustland material.
Style: miniature pre-rendered late-1990s hyper-faux realistic RPG textures. Finely detailed tactile surfaces, low contrast, low saturation, medium-dark lighting. Flat diffuse light, no vignettes, no dramatic highlights. Consistent material scale across all four quadrants; mostly ground rather than foliage.
Constraints: Exact two rows and two columns. Opaque full texture coverage. No people, structures, grass clumps, objects, labels, text, UI, grid lines, large luminous crystals or copyrighted game assets. These are tiled surface materials, not an environment illustration.

prompts.prefabs:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent isometric game prefab atlas for an original game titled Rose.
Primary request: One precise 3 by 3 atlas containing nine independent pre-rendered game objects. Orthographic isometric camera, 30 degree downward elevation, consistent left-front light, physically textured but deliberately miniature late-1990s computer rendered sprites. Hyper-faux realistic druid / nano / neon material aesthetic: dark carved wood, oxidized metal, worn bio-plast, jade crystalline conduits, tiny rose and cyan indicator lights. Low saturation earthy base and sparing luminous accents, tactile surfaces, convincing thickness and contact shading. Not a cartoon, not flat vector, not modern glossy concept illustration.
Composition: Nine equal cells in exactly three columns and three rows with generous transparent gutters. All objects centered in their own cell, fully visible, bases at equal relative vertical positions. No labels, no lettering, no grid lines, no backdrop or floor plane. Each cell approximately same visual scale.
Top row left to right: 1 small wooden wind collector with four blades and nano hub, 2 round oxidized water cistern with jade pipes, 3 low raised planter with darkwood border and lush druid herbs.
Middle row: 4 worn bio-plast tent shelter with darkwood frame, 5 compact artisan workshop bench and low angular canopy with tools, 6 market exchange stall of oxidized metal and bio-plast with bins and rose lamp.
Bottom row: 7 short relay spire of darkwood and nano crystal with cyan light, 8 rough cluster of weathered rocks with a hint of jade veins, 9 small autonomous quadruped survival construct in a low broad silhouette with four legs and rose optical sensor.
Constraints: Exactly nine discrete objects, one per cell, no overlap, transparent background and genuinely clean alpha. Consistent camera, material palette and lighting across every object. Original designs; no characters, copyrighted game assets, logos, UI or text. Sheet aspect square.
prompts.walk:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent walking-animation sprite atlas for original game Rose.
Input image: reference only for consistent pre-rendered materials, palette and miniature rendering, NOT an edit target.
Primary request: Draw ONE SAME adult traveler as a precisely arranged 4-column by 6-row game sprite sheet. Exactly 24 fully separate figures, no props or background. Each row has four successive WALK CYCLE frames viewed from the same direction. Orthographic isometric camera 30-degree down view, consistent left-front lighting and scale. Each pose fully within its equal cell with ample transparent gutters. Feet baseline the same relative position for every cell. Same face, outfit, equipment, height, limb lengths throughout.
Traveler design: an androgynous adult survivalist, short dark hair, weathered moss-green bio-plast coat with pale worn fabric sleeves, oxidized nano clasps, darkwood walking tool carried close to body, compact pack, charcoal trousers and boots, tiny jade conduit and rose indicator on wrist. Original non-military civilian expedition clothes.
Row view directions from top to bottom: 1 faces screen RIGHT (east); 2 faces UPPER RIGHT (northeast, mostly back view); 3 faces UPPER LEFT (northwest, mostly back view); 4 faces screen LEFT (west); 5 faces LOWER LEFT (southwest, mostly front view); 6 faces LOWER RIGHT (southeast, mostly front view).
Each row columns: left foot forward; feet crossing under hips; right foot forward; feet crossing in opposite swing. Keep silhouettes distinct and consistent in-ground contact; don't gradually rotate across a row.
Style: late-1990s pre-rendered hyper-faux realistic 3D sprite. Match the referenced atlas tactile, weathered darkwood / bio-plast / oxidized metal / nano crystals. Earthy low saturation, restrained cyan/jade/rose lights, convincing shaded three dimensional body, slight low-resolution texture character. Not anime, not cartoon, no flat vector, no glossy modern realism.
Composition: portrait-oriented rectangular 4 by 6 equal-cell atlas, exact alignment; isolated full bodies, no overlap, no ground planes, no lettering or numbered cells. Transparent background with genuine alpha. The 24 figures fill their cells with 15 percent padding around each.
prompts.actions:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original Rose game action-pose sprite atlas.
Input image 1: reference for the exact SAME traveler identity, outfit and sprite render style. Create a new sheet, not an edit to the reference sheet.
Primary request: One square transparent sprite atlas, EXACTLY 6 equal columns and 6 equal rows. Exactly 36 independent full-body action poses of the SAME androgynous adult survivalist shown in the reference: short dark hair, moss-green coat, worn pale sleeves, charcoal boots and trousers, compact pack, darkwood staff with jade light, tiny rose wrist lights. Preserve the outfit and body proportions.
Columns left to right for EVERY row: 1 standing idle; 2 striking forward with darkwood staff; 3 defensive braced guard holding staff; 4 crouched repair work handling a small tool; 5 standing conversation gesturing with free hand; 6 collapsed/downed lying on side.
Rows from top to bottom viewing direction: 1 screen RIGHT/east side profile; 2 UPPER RIGHT/northeast mostly back; 3 UPPER LEFT/northwest mostly back; 4 screen LEFT/west side profile; 5 LOWER LEFT/southwest mostly front; 6 LOWER RIGHT/southeast mostly front.
Orthographic isometric camera 30 degrees down, same left-front lighting. Every pose stays within its cell. Feet/contact baseline at 85 percent of the cell height, centered at 50 percent cell width; lying figures contact at the same baseline. Very generous transparent gutters. No cuts, no overlap.
Style: hyper-faux realistic pre-rendered late-1990s game sprites. Tactile weathered bio-plast, darkwood, oxidized metal, tiny nano crystal indicators. Match reference closely, earthy and restrained neon; no cartoon, no vector.
Constraints: true transparent background, no floor plane, no environmental objects, no cast backdrop, no letters, numbers, grid lines or labels. Exact 6x6 cell organization is essential.
